t: Do You Buy Yourself a Birthday Present? | Cup of Jo
s: June 12, 2024 - My birthday is my favorite day, so I 100% buy myself a present. Sometimes it’s a material item, other times it’s a spa day or an expensive dinner out. My 40th birthday was a big year, I gifted myself a Birthday Bachelorette Bridal Extravaganza with my best friends, a VERY fancy purse, and a wedding. This year it was a bottle of scent that I’d been eyeing for over a year. I wish I could say it was a “celebration of myself” or a “I’m proud of myself” gift, but it’s selfishly my birthday and I’m buying myself what I want.
